pages.text: Draw a small circle with Fiery Chalk. Offer Ectoplasm, Blaze Powder and either Coal or Charcoal. Starting costs 333 power, or 283 with Hecate's Visage, and immediately consumes these offerings. The ritual works in any dimension.

For three minutes it spends 25 power each second. Every two elapsed-world seconds, it processes one item from each smeltable dropped stack in the focal block's box expanded three blocks in all directions. Each item has a 70 percent chance to become its furnace result; otherwise it is consumed for two experience points.

Only ordinary furnace recipes count. Container items are excluded. It does not smelt whole stacks at once, use fuel or grant furnace experience on successful conversions. Separate dropped stacks are processed separately. Nearby drops can be consumed, so keep items you want to preserve outside the area.
A full run costs 4,833 power, or 4,783 with the Visage. Stop by clicking the center. Consumed offerings and processed drops are not refunded. Black Dogs now supply Ectoplasm in survival.
